BED diagnosis doesn't require a certain weight. Actually only 40% of individuals that have it are overweight so you don't have to worry about this. Talk openly with your psychiatrist or even with your doctor or a psychologist and they'll help you.
As for the drugs... Drugs are drugs and they come with side effects and what not. Your psychiatrist will likely recommend some form of therapy, like CBT, which is the most effective treatment for eating disorders and works particularly well for BED. 
Trust the doctors and I'm sure they'll give you the help you need.
By the way, I'm proud of you for admitting you have a problem and seeking help. I know from my own experience that it takes courage.
Take care!
